images.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create one photorealistic premium ecommerce editorial product photo for the Trend Shop cosmetics website. The attached reference is the exact product and all of its physical details must remain unchanged: CLINIQUE dramatically different moisturizing lotion+, pale yellow rectangular lotion bottle, black pump, clear cylindrical cap, metallic silver C logo and original label. One bottle upright on a warm ivory stone vanity, soft daylight from the left, subtle natural shadow and quiet champagne reflections. Square composition, bottle occupies about 70 percent height, accurate front label clearly visible, beautiful tactile photographic quality. Preserve the exact reference bottle proportions, pump/cap and printed words; change only environment and lighting. No extra products, added captions, review stars, logos other than original packaging, medical symbols, before/after, SPF claims or watermark.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. One premium cosmetics promotional photograph for Trend Shop. Exact product reference: CLINIQUE dramatically different moisturizing lotion+, same pale yellow bottle with silver C, black pump and clear cap. An elegant fictional adult woman age 28 with dark brown hair, natural skin texture and minimal makeup, fully clothed in a cream blouse, seated at a softly sunlit cream vanity. She gently applies a tiny dot of ordinary moisturizer to her cheek with fingertips while the exact reference bottle stands in the foreground, label facing camera, cap placed naturally beside it. Show face, shoulders and hands, friendly relaxed expression, realistic hands, warm ivory and soft rose colors, square editorial composition. Preserve the bottle design and original printed label faithfully. This is an advertising model, no testimonial text, stars, claims of results, airbrushed perfect skin, before/after, medical symbols, extra products or watermark.
